name: Volcengine Ark
description: Serves ByteDance's Doubao models and third-party models through Volcengine's API, with text, vision, image and video generation plus tool calling, for developers building on Volcengine.

skills.name: Text Generation and Deep Thinking
skills.description: Generates text with optional deep thinking through the Responses and Chat APIs.

skills.name: Multimodal Understanding
skills.description: Analyzes images, video and PDF files, including visual grounding that returns object coordinates.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generates and edits images with Doubao Seedream models.

skills.name: Video Generation
skills.description: Creates video from text, images or reference frames with Doubao Seedance models.

skills.name: Tool Calling
skills.description: Lets models use built-in web search and knowledge-base retrieval, custom functions, and remote MCP servers.
